name: Hunter of Hunters
summary: A Bonus Action marks a creature's weak points so your next damage ignores its Resistances, and you recall lore about creatures with Advantage.

benefits.name: Dead Aim
benefits.summary: Bonus Action: study a creature; the next time you damage it before the start of your next turn, ignore its damage Resistances.
benefits.text: As a Bonus Action you scrutinize a creature to find its weak points. The next time you deal damage to that creature before the start of your next turn, you ignore its damage Resistances, if it has any.

benefits.name: Studied Quarry
benefits.summary: Advantage on ability checks made to recall information about a creature.
benefits.text: You have Advantage on ability checks you make to recall information about a creature (in the game, the Study check against a monster).
